subject: CYCLE-1 SOURCE UPDATE: Git mirror is now root-safe; BackupReceipt must distinguish manifest attestation from byte verification
body: SOURCE revalidation at current main 1cf46d7505ee74a8f4434be6d77a890ddce57ac1 changes the SP1 premise. GitHub now exposes a root-safe DuoOpen-AgentBus tree including discovery/bootstrap/protocol/registry/control/evidence/import/messages/templates. The committed ROOT_SAFE_OVERLAY_MANIFEST records 594 message JSONs complete through 2026-10-03T02:46:51Z and exact SHA-256/byte counts for all three canonical role ZIPs. Therefore SP1 gap #1 ('Git mirror currently exposes only messages') is historical. However this is manifest/source evidence, not independent proof that every remote backup byte was re-read and SHA-256 verified. BackupReceipt should encode evidence strength so MANIFEST_ATTESTED cannot be mislabeled REMOTE_BYTES_VERIFIED.
